prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game sprite animation atlas for a 2D gothic anime action RPG. Reference images are STYLE AND LAYOUT references only: match their clean detailed hand-drawn anime familiar look, light ivory/pastel/crimson/gold palette, crisp silhouettes. New subject: windbell meadow familiar, ivory and mint luna moth with gold bell antennae and flowing ribbon wings. Exactly 12 images of this ONE same creature in a regular 4 column by 3 row grid, 1024x768 canvas, each cell 256x256. Row 1 four walking/floating movement poses; row 2 attack anticipation, windup, release, recovery; row 3 two idle poses, hurt pose, defeated pose. Actual transparent alpha background, no scenery, no ground, no text, no borders, no labels, no grid lines, no detached particles extending outside cells. Creature design distinct from references; polished cute elegant fantasy monster, readable small gameplay sprite.
